structuredData.headline: Anya @ Shorea Park Modern Minimalist — Strategic 2-Bedroom Rental Renovation in Puchong
structuredData.description: A 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom condominium at Anya @ Shorea Park, Puchong renovated on an RM 24,000 all-inclusive budget. Features air conditioning in every room, custom wood-grain L-shaped kitchen cabinetry with built-in hob, modern LED wave chandelier, floating TV console with wainscoting accent wall, and warm neutral interiors designed for high-yield rental appeal.
